name: Ollang
description:
Ollang is the AI Language Execution Platform that turns your AI assistant into a global content team. Ship subtitles, closed captions, AI dubbing, studio dubbing, and document translation into any language — without ever leaving your workflow.

Just describe what you need: upload a video, doc, or subtitle file, kick off an order, and let Ollang handle the rest. Built-in AI QC checks accuracy, fluency, tone, and cultural fit on every deliverable, so nothing ships until it's ready. Track orders, manage revisions, browse projects, and set reusable translation guidelines — all through natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ollang to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ollang to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ollang.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ollang MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ollang lists 37 MCP tools, including appendUploadChunk, assignTranslatorToFolderOrders, beginChunkedUpload, bulkExportFoldersXlsx, cancelChunkedUpload, cancelHumanReview, cancelOrder, createCustomInstruction, createOrder, createRevision, deleteCustomInstruction, and deleteRevision.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ollang?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ollang in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
Ollang requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ollang is developed by Ollang. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
